contracts: Complete authored BLP2 chains through 1x1 for nearest-mip-nearest, linear-mip-nearest and linear-mip-linear filters; missing levels fail with diagnostic status.
Lock once at the original extent, Latch each increasing level, Unlock once after completed Lock even on lower-level failure; dirty retries refresh full chain.
Native immutable mip allocations reject sampler changes across mip/nonmip storage classes and mipped render targets.
Wait 2 waits for local data; native reader contract excludes remote streaming. Modes 1/2 retain the bounded 30-second wait.
Option 0x10 uses original UI priority 129 versus 130; cached requests promote queued tickets without splitting handle identity.
256 MiB shared retained-pixel budget includes all levels and retired requests until release; worker temporaries remain independently bounded.
Owner-thread cache/GPU mutations and retained-worker reads/decode, cancellation, one completion and consumer-before-owner shutdown remain required.
remaining_limits: Frame 0x17 disk lookup and atlas eligibility remain rejected; no silent flag masking.
Alternate/TGA lookup, atlases, default mip policy, anisotropy, generated mips, forced tracking, base-mip aliasing, general async objects and remote streaming remain unavailable.
Original Frame font/string/layout factories, signed ordered FrameXML execution and post-creation digest comparison, and actual GlueXML/login rendering remain open.
Original terrain image minification through UI shaders is a resource check, not world-material rendering or gameplay.
No new physical-input, Windows runtime, macOS graphics, server session, Warden or gameplay acceptance. Preserve external server tag/embedded-revision discrepancies and interactive user sign-in.
